title: What a Client Sees
Is <g>the Tip</g>
subtitle: One good reply. Six things made it good.

cards.title: A reply in your voice
cards.body: On time, on point, sent with your yes.

cards.title: A second AI checks it
cards.body: Scored before you see it, three fixes max.

cards.title: One place to approve
cards.body: Approve, edit or reject in one click.

cards.title: Nothing goes out alone
cards.body: A hard lock checks for an approved id.

cards.title: One shared memory
cards.body: One id per client, in every room.

cards.title: Every edit teaches it
cards.body: Your changes make the next draft closer.
